artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan making suite_selection_select's multi-path aggregation compositional, adapting its two production call sites, updating the Tier Justification authoring contract, pinning the semantics with fixtures, and closing with a redeploy plus dual-vantage verification.

memory_candidates.content: A plan's Tier Justification suite list must be measured with the SAME library copy validate-artifact.sh will use, not whichever is convenient. validate-artifact.sh resolves its selector as "$_validate_script_dir/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh", so running .claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh measures against the DEPLOYED corpus while sourcing agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh measures against the source store. Measured live on this repo: plan-format.md resolves to 4 suites from the source-store copy and 5 from the deployed copy (the extra one being a lean-extension suite). A planner who measures from the source store and is validated from the deployed tree draws a spurious 'under-verifies' warning. Measure with the deployed library, or state the divergence inline in the justification.
